ArtifactMetadata.Summary: Overwrite task.md to outline the tasks for the Notification Center and Local Notifications implementation.

args.CodeContent:
# Tasks: Local Notifications & In-App Notification Center

- `[ ]` Add UI elements for Daily Reminder & Time, and Recurring Alerts settings in `#subscreen-preferences` (index.html)
- `[ ]` Add Header Bell Icon & Badge next to the Cloud sync button (index.html)
- `[ ]` Add `#notification-center-modal` overlay (index.html)
- `[ ]` Add CSS styles for the bell icon, badge, and notification list cards (style.css)
- `[ ]` Implement local storage initialization and state for `state.notifications` (app.js)
- `[ ]` Implement `NotificationManager` methods (scheduling, canceling, permissions request) in app.js
- `[ ]` Add event listener bindings for Header Bell, Preferences form switches, and Notification modal buttons (app.js)
- `[ ]` Connect Note Reminders: schedule on save, cancel on delete/clear (app.js)
- `[ ]` Connect Recurring Alerts: push notification on new recurring generation (app.js)
- `[ ]` Hook Daily Reminder Tap to open Add Transaction Modal (app.js)
- `[ ]` Hook Note Reminder Tap to open Note Editor in Notes Manager (app.js)
- `[ ]` Verify JS syntax with `node -c app.js`
- `[ ]` Build and deploy with `build_and_deploy.ps1`
